title: Repair failure capture before lease quarantine without changing guard safety
scope: SD.md D1-D2 only. D3 (failure-path integration tests), D4-D6 (hosted TRACE/RCA, product FIX, durable diagnostics) and step 5 belong to separate follow-on tasks (DEV502-FAILPATH-001, DEV502-TRACE-001, DEV502-FIX-001, DEV502-OBSERVE-001, DEV502-STOP-001). No hosted dispatch was performed by this task.

root_cause.summary: The prior design ran failure diagnostics as a second, independent invocation of scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh (workflow step id paper_bootstrap_diagnostics) after the paper_bootstrap step had already failed. run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh's own EXIT trap (cleanup_command -> stop_heartbeat_for_quarantine) stops the lease heartbeat synchronously as soon as the first guarded command returns non-zero, so the second guard invocation always failed its own pre-flight heartbeat_is_healthy check with 'lease heartbeat is not healthy before command start', and the collector never ran.
exact_source_lines: .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml (pre-fix): separate paper_bootstrap_diagnostics step reused the same lease/heartbeat state files as a second guard invocation

fix_design.d1_capture_inside_guarded_child: The baseline bootstrap and the failure collector now run inside the same single guarded child (scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh), invoked once by run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh from the paper_bootstrap workflow step. The script captures the baseline's original exit status without `set -e`, and only if it is non-zero does it invoke the collector over the same SSH session while the guard still owns the lease and heartbeat. It always exits with the original baseline status (never `|| true`, never overridden by collector success/failure), so the guard's normal failure recording and quarantine behavior is unchanged.
fix_design.d1_pin_boundary: run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh remains the immutable pinned guard binary from .lease-controller (commit 9e564718da8c39199a4c311f1a667b74226e3428, hash-checked); it was not modified. The new guarded script and the updated collector live under .agora-gate-controller (checked out at the moving dev tip), so this change takes effect on the next deploy run once merged, without moving the lease guard's trust pin.
fix_design.d1_no_bypass: No invalid-lease bypass, heartbeat restart, IAM change, or public endpoint was introduced. The lease-loss fallback capture described in SD D1 (best-effort read after a new lease is acquired by compensation) is out of scope for this task and was not implemented.
fix_design.d2_collector_scope: scripts/collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py now includes the persona service in the fixed SERVICES tuple (matching the actual call path through _persona_record_for_provisioning), and adds an explicit project exception allowlist (PersonaWriteOwnerUnavailable, ProvisioningLeaseLost) alongside the existing generic *Error/*Exception and Postgres-specific matches. An arbitrary 'SomeType: <free text>' line is still never surfaced as an event.
fix_design.d2_envelope_fields: collect() now accepts and records run_id, attempt, phase, expected_fe_sha, and bootstrap_exit, and the result envelope carries top-level container_id/image_id/observed_source_sha (mirrored from the operator-bff row) plus a top-level collection_status ('ok' when every per-service collection_status is 'ok', otherwise 'partial'). Missing/timeout/truncated/identity-mismatch statuses are never rewritten as success.
fix_design.d2_upload_independent_of_failed_step_out: The workflow's upload step (paper_bootstrap_diagnostics_upload) now reads steps.paper_bootstrap.outputs.artifact_path directly. That output is written by the outer (ungated) portion of the paper_bootstrap step after the guard returns, based on whether the runner-local diagnostic directory actually contains collection-status.json or diagnostics.json -- not on the step's own reported outcome text. Collection or upload failure never changes steps.paper_bootstrap's outcome, so deploy_compensation's existing condition (steps.paper_bootstrap.outcome != 'success') is unaffected.

overlap_and_scheduling.dev_delivery_001: DEV-DELIVERY-001 continues to hold the nonprod workflow/lease scope for FE release protocol; this task only touches the diagnostic-capture timing in nonprod-deploy.yml's dev paper baseline steps and does not modify the release/switch protocol. Both share the existing pantheon-dev exclusive resource and serialize through it.
overlap_and_scheduling.pinned_guard_unchanged: scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh was read but not modified; the pinned guard algorithm and its hash pin in nonprod-deploy.yml are untouched.

verification.note: Focused unit/contract tests only. No hosted dispatch, no step 5, no live deploy run.

results.pre_existing_failure_verification_method: Ran the same failing tests against a pristine `git archive HEAD` copy (before this task's changes) in an isolated directory; all 7 already failed identically (environment-dependent: git-history-derived commit hashes and a missing REMOTE_USER var in this sandbox), confirming they are not regressions introduced by this task.
